method: Hand-adjudication by the pilot author against CT.gov records + targeted PubMed searches (drug+design terms, not acronyms). Small samples; verdicts are illustrative feasibility estimates, not precision guarantees.

false_positives_published_but_NCT_uninde.note: STABLE gemigliptin trial, published 2017, NCT absent from all PubMed fields
Glucovance glyburide/metformin vs monotherapy, published 2003 (strong match)

non_publication.precision_note: 6 TP / 9 adjudicated; small n -> wide CI (~0.3-0.9). Implies raw 55% non-pub rate over-estimates TRUE non-publication; bias-corrected ~35-40%, consistent with the trial-publication literature (~30-50% unpublished).
non_publication.recall_note: By construction the flag catches 100% of completed trials with no NCT-databank link; recall of TRUE non-publication is bounded by PubMed databank coverage (a published-but-unindexed trial is missed as a false NON-detection only if it HAS a databank link, which these did not).

enrollment_mismatch.note: ALL 8 are unit-mismatches (substudy / PRO / pooled-PK / analyzed-set), NOT genuine same-trial sample-size discrepancies. The abstract N and registry enrollment routinely denote different populations. Post-fix suppression of abstract_n>registry removed the pooled cases; residual flags remain analyzed-subset FPs. Reliable detection needs randomized/ITT N semantics not available from abstract text.

direction_flip.adjudication: Both pre-fix flags were FALSE POSITIVES: NCT00069784 (ORIGIN) opposite signs 1.02 vs 0.98 with BOTH CIs crossing null (noise, and co-primary mismatch); NCT03211858 driven by a mis-extracted no-CI point. Both suppressed by the both-null and CI-anchor guards. Precision undefined (0 surviving flags); 0 genuine flips in sample.

significance_flip.adjudication: The single flag (NCT01708902) compared the registry HbA1c MEAN (non-sig) against an abstract responder ODDS RATIO (sig) — different endpoints. Removed by family-match gating. 0 genuine flips in sample.

false_positives_all: NCT00097786 (index = NAVIGATOR ambulatory-activity ancillary, not primary)
primary_endpoint_switch.note: The term-overlap heuristic detects 'index abstract does not lexically match the registry primary', dominated by (a) multi-publication trials where the picked index is a secondary/ancillary/review paper and (b) verbose registry endpoint names. It does NOT detect true primary-endpoint switching, which requires the publication's DECLARED primary (methods section / full text), unavailable from the abstract. GAP.

usability_classification.point_extraction_note: Usability SCREENING (is poolable primary data present?) is accurate. But the auto-extracted POINT estimate is unreliable: regex grabs dose numbers ('1.8 mg'->OR 1.8) and HbA1c thresholds ('<=7.0%'->OR 7.0). The point-in-CI self-consistency guard corrects 3/14 CI-anchored points; point-only (no-CI) extractions remain weak. means+-SD extraction is the most reliable path.
